hero_sub_html: From variables and loops to NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, machine learning, algorithms and databases — 45 lessons taking you from absolute zero to data science professional.

about.label: About This Course
paras_html: Python is the world's most beginner-friendly programming language — and also the most powerful for data science, automation and machine learning. This single course takes you from your first variable all the way to building ML models and querying databases.
Designed by Babatunde Awoyemi, Techbase Consultant Services, Ibadan. 45 lessons, 7 phases, completely free.
bullets_html: Variables, data types, strings, lists, tuples, sets and dicts
Functions, OOP, decorators, lambdas and generators
File handling, error handling, modules and packages
NumPy arrays, Pandas DataFrames and data cleaning
Matplotlib and Seaborn for data visualisation
Data structures, algorithms, MySQL and MongoDB

steps.p_html: Python is the ideal first language. Start at lesson 01 with zero coding experience.
Open a terminal and type every code snippet as you read — Python rewards practice.
When you reach NumPy (lesson 24), the lessons will guide you through pip install.
The final lesson is a full reference, interview prep guide and study plan.
